svg.title: Spatial Lattice — pipeline metro map
svg.desc: Geometric metro map of the current pipeline, with separate modules, subworkflows, optional routes and expanded subworkflow details.
svg.text: A shared frame for multimodal tissue imaging
Pipeline metro map / forward-cycle / data flow runs left to right
Exporter accepts exactly one Cellpose method.
MACSima-fixed route used by the exporter
Other fixed frame: bypass channel extraction.
Warp mask = TransformSegMask; requires an H&E mask.
Also consumes native H&E, markers and transforms.
Outputs: one OME-Zarr scene + MultiQC JSON.
Connections occur at stations or explicit branch points. SpatialData and RAMI2D_TRANSFORM are not wired into this export path.
